query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, l.is_active, l.is_test_data, length(coalesce(l.content, '')) as content_length, c.id as chapter_id, c.title as chapter_title, o.id as offering_id, o.is_published as offering_is_published, o.is_test_data as offering_is_test_data, s.name as series_name, lv.name as level_name, sub.name as subject_name, (select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id = l.id) as exercise_count, (select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id = l.id) as quiz_count from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id = o.subject_id join public.levels lv on lv.id = o.level_id join public.series s on s.id = o.series_id where l.id in ('7a0fcff7-b4fc-4cda-aced-0c217220bf97','0f5b8c0b-ab87-41f1-92aa-fadcb5e350d2','08cb1a4b-5483-4d68-9678-5477e0a820f3','0e730715-0cd9-4540-bc23-aa23695e83b1','ff2dfefc-fd76-408c-b7eb-11ee8d725ab7','565da730-ed69-41bc-9283-47f57ee8a82a') order by l.title, s.name limit 6;
